# tsc-errors

Run the TypeScript check; return the error count, the worst files and the first errors.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cmd` | str | no | `bunx tsc --noEmit` | Type-check command |
| `--top` | int | no | `6` | Most files and errors to list |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run tsc-errors
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys errors, files, first, exit.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/tsc-errors.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
